thread:
Ana Gomez: FYI — getting 3 separate onboarding requests from AMs. Short summary: 
- FinTech (Enterprise): wants Llama-3 70B pinned (quantized preferred) in eu-west-1, reproducible outputs required. Ticket #12345.
- Mid-market SaaS: asks for gpt4o-mini in ap-northeast-1 for latency-sensitive chat. Ticket #12346.
- Retail customer: wants older GPT-4 variant pinned (for compliance/regression) — specifically gpt-4-0613. Ticket #12347.
Can product triage and advise next steps? @jon @maya

Jon Rivera: thanks Ana. Two quick Qs: 1) Do AMs want these as "pinned" model versions in hosted catalog or Dedicated/private installs? 2) Any deadlines?

Ana Gomez: All three requested for hosted catalog pinning first. Deadlines: FinTech wants an internal demo in ~6 weeks; SaaS is flexible (~4 wks good); Retail just needs stable reproducibility, no hard date.

Sree Iyer: Tech note: Llama-3 70B q4_0 is feasible but needs kernel/quantization validation. Expect perf hit vs float32 but big mem win. We currently support q4_0 path for 30B family; 70B will need a short runtime change + perf tests. Rough estimate: 3-4 dev sprints to validate + 1 for rollout tests.

Sree Iyer: For clarity, example model id we'll test: `llama-3-70b:q4_0` and for GPT variant `gpt-4-0613` (pinned). We'll need a prompt/regression set from the customer for acceptance tests.

Oliver Chen: Region capacity: hosted in eu-west-1 has enough instances for small/med models. 70B with hunch of q4 still needs GPUs with enough vram (A10G baseline; H100 preferred). If they need guaranteed throughput we'll have to schedule Dedicated reservation or plan for burst across regions. Timeline to ensure H100s in eu-west-1 for this is ~6 weeks with procurement/provisioning.

Maya Patel: I'll take ownership of intake. Proposal for prioritization: 
- Priority A (P1): Security/compliance customers; not these.
- Priority B (P2): FinTech Llama-3-70B (enterprise demo + reproducibility req).
- Priority C (P3): gpt4o-mini in ap-northeast-1 (lower infra risk, faster).
- Priority D (P4): pin gpt-4-0613 for Retail — still needed but lower resource urgency.
I'll create a GH intake issue and tag eng/runtime + infra.

TriageBot: Created intake ticket intake-2026-04-12-987 and added labels: `catalog-onboard`, `region-request`, `customer-driven`.

Jon Rivera: Acceptance criteria proposal (short): 
1) Model appears in hosted catalog with pinned model id and manifest.
2) Perf SLOs: tail latency 95th <= customer agreed numbers (or documented fallback).
3) Regression suite passes on customer's prompt set.
4) Region availability documented + fallback routing policy.
Agree?

Sree Iyer: Agree on criteria. Ask: do we accept quantized variant as "pinned" for customers who require exact reproducibility? Quantization can change outputs slightly. We should require customer sign-off on QoE if we deliver q4 variant.

Ana Gomez: FinTech indicated they're open to q4 if we can certify regression tests. I'll ask AM to collect the prompt set and sign-off form.

Maya Patel: Next steps I will do today: create GH issue, attach tickets #12345/#12346/#12347, assign to @sree for runtime scoping, @oliver for infra/regional capacity. I'll add the acceptance criteria and expected timeline (4-8 weeks depending on model).

Oliver Chen: For the ap-northeast-1 gpt4o-mini request — we can likely enable in hosted within 2 weeks (no heavy infra). I'll add a note to the issue about fallback regions and any cost delta.

Jon Rivera: Cool. @ana please confirm with FinTech that q4 acceptance is ok and get prompt/regression set. Once we have that, Sree can scope work items.

Ana Gomez: Will do, pinging AMs now. :email:

Maya Patel: tagging release-planning channel for visibility after scoping.

Sree Iyer: One more ask from eng: please provide sample production traffic profile (seq length distribution + qps) from each customer if available — helps batching/kv cache config.

Ana Gomez: I'll request that info too.

Maya Patel: ack. I'll update the intake issue with owners and tentative ETA by EOD. :white_check_mark:
